name: det_hagrid_cross
rule: two hand boxes with IoU >= 0.1 (every hand box of the image: gesture hand + no_gesture hand); people of the HaGRID-based benchmarks and near-duplicates of benchmark images excluded; deterministic crc32(id) order, take_picture capped at 2000; frames with a hand whose FAH-L side is unsure (|P(right) - 0.5| < 0.2) dropped
